idea-plugin.name: CodeLens Pro
idea-plugin.description:
CodeLens Pro

CodeLens Pro is a lightweight editor minimap plugin for IntelliJ IDEA. It adds a compact code overview next to the editor, helping you navigate large files faster and understand the structure of your code at a glance.

Features

  • Editor minimap with compact code texture rendering
  • BufferedImage-based raster rendering for smoother minimap output
  • Unified minimap layout so short files are not stretched
  • Fold-aware minimap layout
  • Viewport indicator for quick orientation
  • Caret line marker
  • Error, warning, and markup indicators
  • Resizable minimap width
  • Optional hiding of the default vertical scrollbar
  • Large-file safeguards to reduce memory and UI overhead
  • Toggle action with Ctrl + Shift + G

Inspired by CodeGlance Pro

CodeLens Pro was inspired by the excellent CodeGlance Pro plugin.

  • CodeGlance Pro GitHub: https://github.com/Nasller/CodeGlancePro
  • CodeGlance Pro Marketplace: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/18824-codeglance-pro

This plugin references the general minimap interaction and rendering ideas from CodeGlance Pro, while using its own plugin identity, package namespace, settings, implementation, and user experience. CodeLens Pro is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by the CodeGlance Pro project or its authors.

Privacy

CodeLens Pro works locally inside the IDE. It does not collect, transmit, or store source code, project files, telemetry, or personal data.
